ImageDescription.value:
The Santa Teresa tram route passes over the 45-metre (148ft) high Carioca Aqueduct, a former aqueduct constructed in the 18th century.
It connects the city centre with the primarily residential, inner-city neighbourhood of Santa Teresa. It is considered a heritage tramway system, designated a national historic monument in 1988. It is one of the oldest street railway lines in the world.
